### Subcriterion B2 — Area of Occupancy (AOO)

Subcriterion B2 is assessed by estimating the area of occupancy (AOO) by counting the number of 10 km<sup>2</sup> cells covered by the ecosystem. This method is consistent regardless of the resolution of the ecosystem classification maps, allowing comparison of assessments across ecosystem types at a global scale.

```{r b2_text, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval = !is.null(params$b2_data)}
b2_data    <- params$b2_data
b2_code    <- b2_data$assessment[which.max(as.numeric(b2_data$year))]
b2_n       <- b2_data$n[which.max(as.numeric(b2_data$year))]
b2_nexceed <- b2_data$n_exceed[which.max(as.numeric(b2_data$year))]
# cat(paste0(
#   "From overlaying a 10 \u00d7 10 km grid on the ", params$ecosystem_name,
#   " ecosystem, ", b2_n, " 10 km\u00b2 grid cells intersect the most recent (",
#   max(params$years), ") ecosystem map, which is highlighted in the map below. ",
#   "Small patches of the mapped ecosystem (<1% of total mapped ecosystem area) ",
#   "are then excluded from the total number of intersecting 10 km^2^ grid cells ",
#   "to provide the AOO measurement. From the most recent mapping, the AOO for the ",
#   params$ecosystem_name, " ecosystem is **", b2_nexceed, " grid cells**. ",
#   "This number of grid cells classes the ecosystem as **",
#   assessment_map[b2_code], "** under subcriterion B2."
# ))


cat(paste0(
  "A regular grid with 10 km^2^ cells (100 km^2^) was overlaid on the most recent (**",
  max(params$years), "**) map of the **", params$ecosystem_name,
  "** ecosystem. Of the **", b2_n, "** grid cells intersecting the mapped ecosystem, **", b2_nexceed, "** remained after applying the RLE Guidelines v2.0 correction to exclude cells collectively representing less than 1% of the mapped area. The resulting Area of Occupancy (AOO) of **", b2_nexceed, "** grid cells classifies the ecosystem as **",
  assessment_map[b2_code], "** under subcriterion B2."

))


```

```{r b2_text_missing, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval = is.null(params$b2_data)}
cat(paste0(
  "The area of occupancy (AOO) under subcriterion B2 could not be calculated ",
  "because the 10 x 10km grid data was not created for this assessment."
))
```

```{r b2_detail, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$b2_data)}
# Single-row "card" for B2: status circle, year, grid-cell counts, category.
b2_latest <- latest_b_row(params$b2_data)

b2_row <- data.frame(
  Year      = as.character(b2_latest$year),
  Cells     = as.character(as.numeric(b2_latest$n)),
  AOO       = as.character(as.numeric(b2_latest$n_exceed)),
  Category  = assessment_map[as.character(b2_latest$assessment)],
  Status    = as.character(b2_latest$assessment),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # Columns: status (60px) | year (80) | cells (120) | AOO (160) | category (flex)
  grid_cols <- "60px 80px 120px 160px 1fr"
  
  header_row <- htmltools::div(
    style = sprintf(paste(
      "display: grid;",
      "grid-template-columns: %s;",
      "gap: 12px;",
      "align-items: center;",
      "padding: 6px 14px;",
      "color: #666;",
      "font-size: 0.82em;",
      "text-transform: uppercase;",
      "letter-spacing: 0.04em;",
      "border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;"
    ), grid_cols),
    htmltools::div(""),
    htmltools::div("Year"),
    htmltools::div("Grid cells"),
    htmltools::div("AOO (>1%)"),
    htmltools::div("Category")
  )
  
  data_row <- htmltools::div(
    style = sprintf(paste(
      "display: grid;",
      "grid-template-columns: %s;",
      "gap: 12px;",
      "align-items: center;",
      "padding: 8px 14px;"
    ), grid_cols),
    htmltools::HTML(status_circle(b2_row$Status)),
    htmltools::div(b2_row$Year),
    htmltools::div(b2_row$Cells),
    htmltools::div(b2_row$AOO),
    htmltools::div(b2_row$Category)
  )
  
  htmltools::div(
    style = paste(
      "margin: 12px 0;",
      "border: 1px solid #ddd;",
      "border-radius: 6px;",
      "overflow: hidden;",
      "background: white;"
    ),
    htmltools::div(
      style = paste(
        "padding: 10px 14px;",
        "background: #f0f0f0;",
        "border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;"
      ),
      htmltools::tags$b("B2"),
      htmltools::tags$span(
        " \u2014 Area of Occupancy in the latest assessment year (grid cells; AOO excludes patches < 1%)",
        style = "color: #555; font-size: 0.9em;"
      )
    ),
    header_row,
    data_row
  )
} else {
  ft <- flextable::flextable(b2_row)
  for (st in names(status_palette)) {
    rows_st <- which(b2_row$Status == st)
    if (length(rows_st) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::bg(ft, j = "Status", i = rows_st, bg = status_palette[[st]])
    }
  }
  ft <- flextable::set_caption(
    ft,
    caption = flextable::as_paragraph(
      flextable::as_b("B2 \u2014 "),
      "Area of Occupancy in the latest assessment year (grid cells; AOO excludes patches < 1%)"
    )
  )
  flextable::autofit(flextable::theme_booktabs(ft, bold_header = TRUE))
}
```
